name: VNC Client
description: The `vnc` component connects to a VNC server and shows its screen on a [display](https://esphome.io/components/display/). It connects when the device starts, reconnects by itself when the server goes away, and can send touches, key presses and pointer clicks back to the server.

config_entries.label: Password
config_entries.description: The VNC password, if the server asks for one. VNC uses only the first 8 bytes: 8 characters for plain letters, digits and symbols, fewer if the password has accented or other special characters.

config_entries.label: Display ID
config_entries.description: The display to draw on. Only needed if there is more than one display.

config_entries.label: Host
config_entries.description: The IPv4 address or hostname of the VNC server.

config_entries.label: Touchscreen ID
config_entries.description: A [touchscreen](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/) on the same display. Touches are sent to the server as left mouse button clicks and drags.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The `vnc` client to connect or disconnect. Only needed if there is more than one.

config_entries.label: Max Update Delay
config_entries.description: The longest a change waits for the picture to stop changing. If the picture never stops changing, for example because of a moving background, the display refreshes about this often. Defaults to `1s`. On e-paper, a few seconds often looks better.

config_entries.label: Pixel Format
config_entries.description: The colour format to ask the server for. `rgb565` uses 2 bytes per pixel and shows all grey levels of a 16-level e-paper panel. `rgb332` uses half the data but shows only about 8 grey levels. `auto` uses `rgb332` on black and white displays and `rgb565` on all others. Defaults to `auto`.

config_entries.label: Port
config_entries.description: The port of the VNC server. Defaults to `5900`.

config_entries.label: Reconnect Interval
config_entries.description: How long to wait before the first new connection attempt after a failure. The wait doubles with each further failure, up to 60 seconds or `reconnect_interval`, whichever is longer. Defaults to `5s`. After a configuration problem, for example when the server is not a VNC server or asks for a password that is not set, the client waits 5 minutes instead. After a wrong password it stops retrying until the device restarts or `vnc.connect` runs.

config_entries.label: Update Delay
config_entries.description: How long the picture must stay unchanged before the display refreshes. This turns an animation into one refresh that shows where the animation ended. Defaults to `200ms`.
